description: Census P60-273, printed page 14: Figure 8 (number in poverty and poverty rate, 1959 to 2020) with its notes and source, the bulleted list of 2019 to 2020 changes, the Overall Poverty section in three columns, and footnotes 45 and 46.

contains_in_order: The official poverty rate in 2020 was 11.4 percent with 37.2 million people in poverty
The poverty rate in 2020 was not statistically different from the poverty rate in 2018, which was 11.8 percent.
The increase in poverty coincided with the 2020 recession associated with the COVID-19 pandemic.

not_heading: not statistically different from 2019 (Figure 12 and Table B-2).
